stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Students learned that weather is not only something on a phone screen.”?
options: It can hold the memory of what a place once believed about itself.
The old swing reminded everyone that a place can change without losing its story.
It can be measured, watched, and understood from the place where you stand.
Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.
